Position Overview

 As a Software Tester at Dumroo.ai, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality, functionality,and performance of our educational platform. You will collaborate withcross-functional teams to design and execute comprehensive testing strategies,identify defects, and contribute to the overall reliability of our technologystack through manual and automated testing approaches.
 Key Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and execute comprehensive test plans and test cases for web applications, APIs, and mobile interfaces

• Perform manual testing including functional, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing

• Develop and maintain automated test scripts using modern testing frameworks

• Collaborate with development teams to identify, document, and track software defects

• Conduct API testing and validation of data pipelines and integrations

• Participate in code reviews from a quality assurance perspective

• Work closely with product managers to understand requirements and ensure comprehensive test coverage

• Perform performance and load testing to ensure system scalability

• Contribute to continuous improvement of testing processes and methodologies

• Participate in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives
